top_signals.title: Bond investors become oil traders as Iran war drives yields
top_signals.summary: Bond investors watch Iran conflict and crude price for signs as to where government borrowing costs will go
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Lufthansa Sees Another Transitional Year With Oil, Fleet Issues
top_signals.summary: Deutsche Lufthansa AG Chief Executive Officer Carsten Spohr predicted another year of financial and operational challenges ranging from uncertain aircraft deliveries to high oil prices and cost pressure at home that will force the airline to sharpen efficiencies.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.

top_signals.title: Demand Boost for US Crops Still Unclear After China Tariff Cuts
top_signals.summary: A day after China announced tariff cuts across a slew of US agricultural products, crop traders are trying to parse whether — and how quickly — that will translate into a demand pickup for major grains.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: European banks launch in-house ETFs to challenge BlackRock and Vanguard
top_signals.summary: Groups launch in-house ETFs to capture retail clients as market booms
top_signals.why_it_matters: Digital asset volatility and institutional crypto positioning changes.

top_signals.title: BlueBay RBC: Global Bond Market Selloff is 'Overdone'
top_signals.summary: The global selloff in government bonds is "overdone" and a turn in the market is due, according to Mark Dowding, fixed income CIO at RBC BlueBay. Speaking on Bloomberg Television, he says the selloff was "not really justified" judging from data including inflation. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Inflation expectations impacting rate path, bonds and global risk assets.
